test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: maths
question: A solid metallic cuboid of dimensions 12 cm × 54 cm × 72 cm is melted and converted into 8 cubes of the same size. What is the sum of the lateral surface areas (in cm²) of 2 such cubes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of 8 cubes = Volume of Cuboid

8 × a³ = 12 × 54 × 72

a³ = 12 × 54 × 9 ⇒ a³ = 5832 ⇒ a = 18 cm

Lateral Surface Area of 2 cubes = 2 × (4a²) = 8 × 18²

Total LSA = 8 × 324 = 2592 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 2592 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Dimensions of cuboid = 12 cm × 54 cm × 72 cm, Number of cubes = 8.

**Formula:** Volume of cuboid = L × B × H; Volume of cube = a³; LSA of cube = 4a².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ccee634d6e34c24b96460b9d0014b20eba225e96046993a9abedd689c19398d.png] 

⇒ Volume of cuboid = 12 × 54 × 72 = 46656 cm³.

⇒ Volume of 8 cubes = 46656 cm³.

⇒ Volume of 1 cube = 46656 ÷ 8 = 5832 cm³.

⇒ a³ = 5832 ⇒ a = √³5832 = 18 cm.

⇒ Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of 1 cube = 4a².

⇒ LSA of 1 cube = 4 × (18)² = 4 × 324 = 1296 cm².

⇒ Sum of LSAs of 2 cubes = 2 × 1296 = 2592 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 2592 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cube and Cuboid

TSA of a cube = 6a² and TSA of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl).

Diagonal of Cube and Cuboid

Length of the longest rod (diagonal) in a cube = a√3 and in a cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²).

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

LSA refers to the area of the vertical faces only. For a cube, it is 4a²; for a cuboid, it is 2h(l + b).</p
